design_decisions: Keep map as the dominant surface.
Keep global navigation/search/city context separate from map-only controls.
Use one canonical map action strip and avoid duplicate control ownership.
Use progressive disclosure for neighborhood detail.
Keep static reference values, observed listings, analytical estimates, and live signals visually distinct.
Reuse Vazirmatn, existing semantic tokens, 4px spacing scale, and 44px primary mobile touch targets.
Use one canonical collapsed/peek/expanded state to drive visual geometry, aria state, backdrop, and map availability.
Keep 40dvh peek and 86dvh expanded as utility/test baseline; resolve 72px vs 78px collapsed after validating nav and safe-area geometry.
Use a dedicated >=44px drag handle, full pointer lifecycle, and explicit tap alternatives.
Assign one canonical visible owner to every map action; keep global navigation, map context actions, and canvas navigation controls in separate groups.
Treat MapQuickControlsStrip as an integration gap to resolve deliberately; do not mount it without reconciling duplicate buy/rent and ruler controls.
Keep the spatial ruler in one canonical location and delegate to the existing RadarWorkspaceShell mode handler.
Require rendered-DOM target-size, overlap, focus, RTL/LTR, and light/dark evidence before accepting placement.
Unify panel visibility and inspector detent under one typed workspace state authority; components should dispatch actions rather than maintain competing visibility copies.
Derive actual rendered inspector geometry from one shared geometry config only after browser evidence resolves 72px vs 78px collapsed height and current vh drift.
Treat spatial measure as an interaction mode coordinated by the shell, not as a sheet state.
Keep neighborhood identity, mode/budget fit, and one mode-relevant price anchor as the persistent inspector header hierarchy.
Place evidence class and sample coverage adjacent to price claims; never imply complete-market coverage or live freshness without source evidence.
Keep scorecard, market, bargains, reviews, and vote as distinct task-oriented tabs with tailored empty/loading/error and disclosure behavior.
Prioritize scorecard affordability decisions above secondary calculators and deep analytical modules; defer long content without hiding methodology.
Treat overlay z-index values as semantic layer roles governed by a workspace contract; inspect stacking-context ancestry and portal ownership before changing numeric tokens.
Position map utilities against a shared measured mobile-navigation/safe-area contract rather than undocumented per-breakpoint bottom offsets.
Treat source z-index inventory as risk evidence only; rendered overlap requires computed styles, bounding boxes, and pointer/focus verification.
Use one documented overlay coordinator for modal stack order, focus ownership, dismissal policy, and scroll-lock lifecycle.
Keep coordinator stack order, DOM order, and visual stacking order aligned; only the topmost dialog handles Escape and sequential focus.
Require stack-aware focus restoration, explicit background inertness, accessible naming, and independent modal content scrolling.
Treat current modal z-index conflicts as source-level risks until simultaneous states and rendered stacking contexts are verified.
Represent active modal ownership explicitly in a central typed coordinator; allow concurrency only for intentional parent-child dialog stacks.
Associate each focus-management ref with exactly one dialog root and ensure only the coordinator's top stack entry handles Escape and Tab.
Do not assume independently supplied modal booleans are mutually exclusive unless source transitions or behavioral tests prove that invariant.
